Chapter 6952: No Connection

Chapter 6952: No Connection

Breaker entered the river directly rather than just crossing from one temporal sphere to another. Spectators saw him disappearing but it was different for Li Qiye.

Those who paid attention saw him standing still in the same place. Apex and Heaven’s Equal didn’t notice anything amiss.

Breaker was as pale as could be, a stark contrast to his previous imperious self.

“Why struggle against the inevitable?” Li Qiye said.

Breaker looked around and saw Heaven’s Equal and Apex, shouting: “Brothers, our branches stand together, please assist me in killing him!”

For epochs now, the three have maintained a delicate balance in Ancient. They preferred peace over conflict.

Apex and Heaven’s Equal exchanged glances, not wanting to be involved. They didn’t wish to face an enemy they didn’t understand. Thus, they kept a distance from Breaker.

“Fellow Daoist, we do have a pact but it is only against a foreign invader harming Ancient.” Heaven’s Equal shook his head and added: “This is a feud caused by your son.”

“Yes, this does not apply.” Apex also refused.

No one found this surprising because who would want to be on top of a sinking ship? Moreover, Breaker had no friends to speak of in Heavenrealm.

“Don’t make a fool out of yourself now, just accept death.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Brother Apex, you owe me a favor, it is time to repay it.” Breaker didn’t give up.

Apex’s expression changed. He hesitated for a moment and said: “Yes, a favor.”

“Brother, we are connected by fate.” Apex bowed at Li Qiye.

“No.” Li Qiye smiled.

Apex turned slightly red and felt awkward. He was the oldest and strongest immortal in Ancient. Thus, others always gave him face. It didn’t work this time.

If he had taken the time to see Li Qiye’s group, perhaps history would have changed.

“Brother, I have a valuable piece of information. Is that enough to trade for Brother Breaker’s life?” He didn’t give up.

“Depends on its value.” Li Qiye said.

“It might be on someone you are looking for.” Apex said, albeit without confidence.

“Who?” Li Qiye asked.

“The master of Myriad Thoughts Pot.” He gritted his teeth and said.

Li Qiye instantly appeared before him; no one saw how he moved.

Apex immediately staggered backward upon seeing Li Qiye’s serious expression. He had met Heavenfall, Dusk, Zhao Dachui... This was something else entirely.

Other immortals also became afraid as if the high heaven was falling. Remember, Li Qiye merely changed his expression; there was no power activation.

“I can let you know if you show mercy.” Apex bowed again.

“Unfortunately, you are in no position to haggle with me.” Li Qiye said.

“!” Apex became alarmed at the threat.
